LocalizedProperties.ProductDescription: Load up and roll out, in this twin stick shooter with roguelike progression! Blast your way through arcade-style levels, using pinball-style physics mixed with an arsenal of devastating weapons. Defeat waves of enemy bots, battle big bosses, and upgrade your mech between runs!
LocalizedProperties.ShortDescription: Load up and roll out, in this twin stick shooter with roguelike progression! Blast your way through arcade-style levels, using pinball-style physics mixed with an arsenal of devastating weapons. Defeat waves of enemy bots, battle big bosses, and upgrade your mech between runs!

Features: Adrenaline Journey: Neon-lit chaos meets strategy in a dynamic twin-stick shooter with acrobatic 3D platform maneuvers, backed by an interactive soundtrack
Mech Mayhem: Four gun-wielding mechs offer unique arsenals, abilities, and upgrades. Navigate evolving landscapes, battling robots, bosses, and arcade-style obstacles
Dynamic Movement: Soar above chaos, bounce off bumpers, and ride updrafts for strategic advantage. Launch missiles, summon allies, and create seismic disruptions
Customizable Arsenal: Over 25 tools and 20+ abilities allow personalized mech customization. Explore visually stunning worlds teeming with enemies and challenges
Interactive Soundtrack: Every action generates a physics-driven, unique soundscape, enhancing the immersive audio-visual experience of the game
Varied Gameplay: Choose between walking and shooting or rolling and bumping, navigating dynamic arenas with diverse movement options
Strategic Upgrades: Enhance mechs with 50+ upgrades, creating a personalized combat experience and adding depth to gameplay
Arcade Roguelite: An electrifying fusion of skill, strategy, and chaos awaits in this action-packed twin-stick shooter with roguelite elements
